Hi Liam — welcome, and thanks for sending everything over. A few quick asks so Finance and Procurement can finalize the pay profile:

1) Can you confirm the micro-deposit amounts once they hit (we'll verify on our side)?
2) For remittance mapping, we prefer the following remittance string layout so invoices attach to the right PO automatically: PO:{PO_NUMBER} | INV:{INVOICE_NUMBER} | VENDOR_REF:{VENDOR_REF}
   - Example: PO:PO-78421 | INV:INV-2027-334 | VENDOR_REF:VENPAY-01
3) Please confirm whether the bank letter authorizes both ACH debit and credit (some banks mark restrictions).

Once we validate the micro-deposits and confirm the bank letter scope, Procurement will create the vendor record and share the vendor ID. Finance (cc'ed) will then schedule the first remittance test (low-dollar wire) to confirm wire path.

If you can reply with a short confirmation and the micro-deposit amounts, we'll move this forward today.

Best,
